subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public and persisted fourth cron run status, including Gateway, Plugin SDK, hook, CLI, and UI contracts, or should yielded waiting remain an internal active-task state?
rationale: The bug fix is valid, but choosing a new externally observable status changes compatibility and product semantics beyond a mechanical repair; runtime proof cannot decide that contract.

options.title: Approve public `deferred`
options.body: Accept the fourth status after adding explicit fresh-install, upgrade, older-client, exact-head cron, and Discord settlement proof.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve yielded parents as active internal task state and expose completion only when the parent reaches an existing terminal cron status.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Land the shared lifecycle and reconciliation fix first, then review the public status, SDK, CLI, and UI expansion separately.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Preserve yielded parents as active internal task state and expose completion only when the parent reaches an existing terminal cron status.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior feature-history work owns the closest descendant aggregation and parent completion semantics, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the lifecycle contract decision.
